data.title: Oxo-Biodegradable Disposable Bags - 50 Bags (Small) *
data.body_text:
• Environment-friendly bags for easy and discreet disposal of hygiene products.

• These bags are tear and tamper proof making them travel friendly too.

• Adhesive seal locks the odour and prevents spilling of the waste.

• Decreases human contact with waste, thus preventing waste pickers from catching any disease.

•
Oxo-biodegradable bags for eco-friendly disposal.

rules.name: Biodegradable plastic: no microplastics, a label with days and environment, and a CPCB certificate
rules.summary: Biodegradable plastic must degrade by biological processes without leaving microplastics or visible or toxic residue, must state the number of days and the environment in which it degrades, and its maker needs a CPCB certificate.
